metadata.qualification: old focus outcomes viewed; new injected scenes/noise/fit outcomes not evaluated before protocol freeze

upstream.qualification: old and corrected calibration outcomes were already viewed; no new profile grids or derivative probes before this design

fitter.neighbor_flux: signed Jy, known fixed controlled position when present
fitter.shape_coefficients: one previously sealed vector; never re-estimated here

rules.gate_origin: developmental necessary effect/support budgets, not NASA mission requirements or physical accuracy certification
rules.matched_truth: original nearest ePSF mathematical template, including signed wings/center-Omega convention; software inverse-crime control only

noise.algorithm: PCG64 SeedSequence([prefix, draw]); C-order full single-exposure image bank
noise.qualification: replicates independent conditional on fixed observed variance; strata are paired and not independent new fields
noise.sharing: same physical native pixel/draw across geometry, phase, scene, flux and fitter arms; null uses first eight banks

rules.noiseless_clean_gate: ALL 128 planned isolated/modeled fits: completed, numerical support, radial error<=.1 native px, flux ratio in [.9,1.1]
rules.noisy_clean_gate: each of 16 fixed clean strata: at least 15/16 complete+supported+positive flux with radial<=.5 native px and flux ratio [.5,1.5]; observed-sample guard only

null.qualification: fitted signed flux and positive-supported outcomes only; no calibrated detector or source position truth

rules.power: with n16 even16/16 exact95% lower~.794 and15/16~.698; probability observed>=15/16 at p=.9~.515. Not powered to certify90% population recovery. Null n8 zero upper~.369.
rules.preservation_guard: all 64 clean noiseless pairs complete, no new numerical refusal, radial degradation<=.02 native px and absolute flux-ratio-error degradation<=.02
rules.quadrature_guard: selected L1 difference <= 1e-12+1e-10*selected mass, no mask renormalization

scenes.modeled: target plus known fixed companion, fitted signed Jy
scenes.omitted: same target+companion truth as modeled but no companion column in fitter; misspecification stress only

rules.scope: post-hoc development on two already opened training-star geometries, one exposure; synthetic means replace IMAGE
rules.search_anchor: source-present: original registered Gaia common position; null only: phase-specific native anchor mapped to common, no source truth
rules.solid_angle: independent Gaussian per-pixel Omega; matched and fitters frozen center Omega; ratios retained, cross-family comparison is compound
rules.uncertainty: two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson for fixed noisy/null strata; mean-ratio MCSE conditional on completed draws; no total astrometric covariance
